cases.name: SL-01: clean launch shows empty state and usable settings
SL-02: discovers a session and renders exact model and cumulative metrics
SL-03: appended telemetry updates the rendered metrics within five seconds
SL-04: switching sessions keeps each session metrics isolated
SL-05: cumulative token_count and overlapping usage records are not added together
SL-06: context estimate requires complete latest usage and a known limit
SL-07: recorded compaction appears in the selected session timeline
SL-08: malformed, partial, rotated, and truncated files retain valid history and report errors
SL-09: preferences, selected session, recent history, and window bounds persist after restart
SL-10: distinguishable child sessions are attributed to the correct parent
SL-13: packaged Apple Silicon app launches and supports navigation, directories, and keyboard search
SL-08 additional: an in-place rewrite that grows the file replays safely
SL-04 additional: mismatched identities and invalid counts cannot contaminate a session
SL-14 local ingestion makes no HTTP uploads; renderer cannot connect or access Node
SL-11 actual Codex CLI session has the same rendered usage as its real rollout
SL-12 installed Codex desktop is present; manual selection is explicitly unsupported for automatic switching
